paite: Huan TOUPA'N David kiang ah Nathan asawl hi. Akiang ah ava hoh a, hichi in achi, "Khua khat ah mi nih a-om ua; khat pen mihausa ahi a, khat pen mizawng ahi.
heading: Nathan Thugen Leh David Kisikna
english: Yahweh sent Nathan to David. He came to him, and said to him, “There were two men in one city: the one rich, and the other poor.

paite: Mihausa in belamhon tampi leh ganhon tampi anei hi.
english: The rich man had very many flocks and herds,

paite: Mizawng in bel belamnou anu neuchik khat lei a, avulh kia lou ngal bangmah dang anei kei hi. Amah leh atate toh khangliankhawm in akuang sawkpih leh anou kikoppih, a-angsung a om, atanu bang geih a angaihtuah ahi.
english: but the poor man had nothing, except one little ewe lamb, which he had bought and raised. It grew up together with him and with his children. It ate of his own food, drank of his own cup, and lay in his bosom, and was like a daughter to him.

paite: Mihausa kiang ah khualzinmi khat ava tung hi. Akiang a mikhual tung ama belam leh gan goh ding phal lou in mizawngpa belamnou leh ganhon a pan agohsak zawta hi," achi hi.
english: A traveler came to the rich man, and he didn’t want to take of his own flock and of his own herd to prepare for the wayfaring man who had come to him, but took the poor man’s lamb and prepared it for the man who had come to him.”

paite: Huchi in huai mi tung ah David aheh mahmah a, Nathan kiang ah, "TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi, huai thilhihmi asih ngeingei ding ahi.
english: David’s anger burned hot against the man, and he said to Nathan, “As Yahweh lives, the man who has done this deserves to die!

paite: Hichibang thil ahih ziak leh hehpihna aneih louh ziak in abelamnou amun li a adit ding ahi," achi hi.
english: He must restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing and because he had no pity!”

paite: Nathan in David kiang ah, "Huai mipa nangmah na hi. TOUPA, Israelte’ Pathian in hichi in achi: Israelte kumpipa ding in thau ka hon nilh a, Saul khut a pan ka hon hunkhia hi.
english: Nathan said to David, “You are the man! This is what Yahweh, the God of Israel, says: ‘I anointed you king over Israel, and I delivered you out of the hand of Saul.

paite: Na pu in ka hon luahsak a, na pu zite na angsung ah ka koih hi. Israel leh Judah inkote ka hon pia a; huaite atawm luat uleh thil dangte leng hon piakbeh lai ding ka hi.
english: I gave you your master’s house and your master’s wives into your bosom, and gave you the house of Israel and of Judah; and if that would have been too little, I would have added to you many more such things.

paite: Bangziak a TOUPA thupiak ngaineu a, amitmuh a thil hoih lou na hih maizen? Hit mi Uriah namsau in na that a, azi na zi ding in na neihsak a, Ammon suante namsau in amah na that hi.
english: Why have you despised Yahweh’s word, to do that which is evil in his sight? You have struck Uriah the Hittite with the sword, have taken his wife to be your wife, and have slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon.

paite: Huaiziak in namsau in na insung anuse ngei nawn kei ding. Kei hon ngaineu a, Hit mi Uriah zi na zi dia na lak ziak in.
english: Now therefore the sword will never depart from your house, because you have despised me and have taken Uriah the Hittite’s wife to be your wife.’

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Ngai in, nangmah inkote mah nang kalh ding thil hoih lou ka tungkhe dia, na mitmuh mahmah in na zite ka hon laksak dia, na inveng ka pe dia, ama'n hiai sun khovak in na zite akithuahpih ding.
english: “This is what Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will raise up evil against you out of your own house; and I will take your wives before your eyes and give them to your neighbor, and he will lie with your wives in the sight of this sun.

paite: Nang aguk in na hih a, ke'n Israel mite tengteng mitmuh in sun khovak in ka hih ding," achi hi.
english: For you did this secretly, but I will do this thing before all Israel, and before the sun.’”

paite: David in Nathan kiang ah, "TOUPA tung ah ka khialta," achi hi. Nathan in David kiang ah, "TOUPA'N leng na khelhna akoihmangta. Na si kei ding.
english: David said to Nathan, “I have sinned against Yahweh.” Nathan said to David, “Yahweh also has put away your sin. You will not die.

paite: Himahleh hiai na thilhih a Pathian gensiatna dia hun lemtang thupitak TOUPA melmate na piak ziak in nang a pan hong piang ding naupang asi ngeingei ding," achi hi.
english: However, because by this deed you have given great occasion to Yahweh’s enemies to blaspheme, the child also who is born to you will surely die.”

paite: Huchi in Nathan in a-inn ah apaisanta hi. Uriah zi in David asuansak naupang tung ah TOUPA'N akhut kha in, achi ana mahmahta hi.
heading: David Tapa Sihna
english: Then Nathan departed to his house. Yahweh struck the child that Uriah’s wife bore to David, and he was very sick.

paite: Huaiziak in David in naupang a ding in Pathian kiang ah angen ngutngut a, an angawl a, alut a, zankhua in lei ah alum hi.
english: David therefore begged God for the child; and David fasted, and went in and lay all night on the ground.

paite: A-inkote lak a upate athou ua, lei a pan kaithou ding in akiang ah adingh uhi. Himahleh athou nuam kei a, akiang uah leng ane sam kei.
english: The elders of his house arose beside him, to raise him up from the earth; but he would not, and he didn’t eat bread with them.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani sagih ni in naupang asita hi. David sikhate'n naupang asita chih ahilh ngam kei uh, "Ngai in, naupang adam lai in akiang ah thu i gen ua, angaikhe nuam kei a. Naupang asita chih bangchi in i hilh ngamta ding ua? Bangchi hiam in thil hoih lou akihih kha ding," achi uhi.
english: On the seventh day, the child died. David’s servants were afraid to tell him that the child was dead, for they said, “Behold, while the child was yet alive, we spoke to him and he didn’t listen to our voice. How will he then harm himself if we tell him that the child is dead?”

paite: Himahleh David in asikhate kisimhou amuh in naupang asita chih atheita hi. David in asikhate kiang ah, "Naupang sita hia?" achi a, amau, "Asita,” achi uh.
english: But when David saw that his servants were whispering together, David perceived that the child was dead; and David said to his servants, “Is the child dead?” They said, “He is dead.”

paite: Huchi in David lei a pan athou a, akisil a, sathau akinilh a, apuante akheng a; TOUPA' inn ah ahoh a, Pathian abia hi. A-inn ah apai nawn a, an akan a, ama ah alui ua, aneta hi.
english: Then David arose from the earth, and washed and anointed himself, and changed his clothing; and he came into Yahweh’s house, and worshiped. Then he came to his own house; and when he requested, they set bread before him and he ate.

paite: Huchi in asikhate'n akiang ah, "Na thilhih bangchidan ahia? Naupang adam lai in an na ngawl a, na kap a, himahleh naupang asihtak in na thou a, an na ne a," achi uhi.
english: Then his servants said to him, “What is this that you have done? You fasted and wept for the child while he was alive, but when the child was dead, you rose up and ate bread.”

paite: Ama'n, "Naupang adam lai in an ngawl in ka kap hi. Naupang adamna ding in TOUPA'N hon hehpih khamoh kei ding chih kua ahia thei? Ka chi hi.
english: He said, “While the child was yet alive, I fasted and wept; for I said, ‘Who knows whether Yahweh will not be gracious to me, that the child may live?’

paite: Himahleh tu in asita ngal a, bang ding in an ka ngawl dia? Ka pikik nawn thei dia hia? Akiang ah ka pai dia, himahleh amah ka kiang ah ahong kik nawn kei ding," achi hi.
english: But now he is dead. Why should I fast? Can I bring him back again? I will go to him, but he will not return to me.”

paite: Huchi in David in azi Bathsheba alungmuan a, akiang ah alut a, akithuahpih a, tapa asuang a, amin Solomon asa hi. TOUPA'N amah a-it hi.
heading: Solomon Pianna
english: David comforted Bathsheba his wife, and went in to her, and lay with her. She bore a son, and he called his name Solomon. Yahweh loved him;

paite: Huchi in zawlnei Nathan athukhak a, ama'n TOUPA ziak in amin Jedidiah asa hi.
english: and he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet, and he named him Jedidiah, for Yahweh’s sake.

paite: Huchi in Joab in Ammon suante khopi Rabbah sim in alata hi.
heading: David In Rabbah Ala / (1 Kro 20.1-3)
english: Now Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and took the royal city.

paite: Joab in David kiang ah mi asawl a, "Rabbah ka sim a, tuite khopi ka lata hi.
english: Joab sent messengers to David, and said, “I have fought against Rabbah. Yes, I have taken the city of waters.

paite: Tu in mi om lai teng kaikhawm inla, khopi sual tum in zuan inla, la in. Ke'n khopi la leng ka min apu kha ding," achi hi.
english: Now therefore gather the rest of the people together, and encamp against the city and take it; lest I take the city, and it be called by my name.”

paite: Huchi in David in mi tengteng akaikhawm a, Rabbah ah ahoh ua, ava sim ua, alata uhi.
english: David gathered all the people together and went to Rabbah, and fought against it and took it.

paite: Akumpipa uh lallukhu khuk lai alaksak a, agikdan dangka-eng talent khat ahi a, suangmantamte leng atel hi. David akhusak ua, khopi ah gallak tampi ala uhi.
english: He took the crown of their king from off his head; and its weight was a talent of gold, and in it were precious stones; and it was set on David’s head. He brought a great quantity of plunder out of the city.

paite: Huchi in asung a om mipite apikheta a, sing-atnate, leilehna sikzumte leh sik heipite zang in nna asemsak hi. Lei haltakte abawlsak a; Ammon suante khopi tengteng ah huchibang in ahih hi. Huchi in David leh mi tengteng Jerusalem ah apaikik nawnta uhi.
english: He brought out the people who were in it, and put them to work under saws, under iron picks, under axes of iron, and made them go to the brick kiln; and he did so to all the cities of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
